verdict.rationale: First-party docs say official SDKs exist for Python, TypeScript, Go and Java, alongside a CLI and REST API, under one API key and SDK across Parse, Extract, Classify, Split and Index. A concrete Python call is documented (client.parsing.parse), and the GitHub repo points users to the official llama-cloud>=1.0 Python package. Missing for 10: code samples or depth for the TypeScript/Go/Java SDKs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality (the repo also shows a package migration, which adds some churn).
